description: Statutory monthly gross minimum wage in one European country, published for January and July each year, in euro (default), national currency or purchasing power standards. Answers "what is the minimum wage in Germany or Spain". Source: Eurostat dataset earn_mw_cur. Countries without a national statutory minimum wage (such as Italy, Austria, Denmark, Finland, Sweden) return no values. (cost: 1 credit)

currency.description: string, optional: 'EUR' (default), 'NAC' (national currency) or 'PPS' (purchasing power standard)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent half-years, 1-100, default 2

name: eu_minimum_wage
